question: Can I obtain a complete offline Excel copy of this Feishu Bitable view?
trigger: A user has a Feishu Bitable view URL and requests an XLSX export
A user needs an offline backup of data they can legitimately view
decision: Accept the generated XLSX as a complete offline copy
Stop and resolve access or completeness failures before relying on an export
evidence: User-provided complete Feishu Bitable view URL
Data returned to the user's authorized browser session
Visible view field metadata and record count where applicable
success_measure: A clean installation produces a readable XLSX whose visible columns and validated record count match the requested source view.
outcome: One locally saved, validated XLSX workbook for the requested Bitable view.
intended_users: Users with legitimate Feishu Bitable view access
use_cases: User-authorized view export after manual sign-in

examples.invocation: /feishu-bitable-export 把这个飞书多维表格导出为 Excel

permissions_systems: Network access to the user-provided *.feishu.cn view
Write permission for the requested XLSX path

documentation_sources: Bundled README and npm package metadata
data_sources: The Bitable data returned to the page in the user's current isolated session

permissions: Read only the user-requested Bitable view
approval_required: Explicit approval before overwriting an existing output

authoritative_sources: Data exposed to the authorized Feishu Bitable web view
relationships: A view orders visible fields from a table; records contain values for table fields
field_semantics: Visible field order comes from view metadata; select option IDs map to configured labels
invariants: Unfiltered export record count must equal source metadata count; exported columns must be visible view fields
freshness_and_pagination: Initial metadata may contain partial records; remaining records must be merged and validated before output
nullability: Record cell values may be null; table metadata, target view, and visible field list are required
readiness_checks: Source view metadata contains target fields

should_trigger: 导出飞书多维表格为 Excel
备份这个 Feishu Bitable 视图
下载公开飞书表格到 xlsx
should_not_trigger: 修改飞书表格中的数据
整理普通 Excel 文件
